{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0616","text":"Yara / Ben - Wren migration catch-up
Thursday, 2:00 PM - 2:30 PM
Location: Yara's office (the one with the squeaky chair) or Zoom if you're out

Hey Ben,

Grabbing a half hour so I can walk you through where things landed on the Wren migration while you were out at the shoot last week. Nothing's on fire, I promise. I just figured it'd be easier to sit down than have you dig through forty Slack threads.

Here's roughly what I want to cover:

1. Where we ended up on the asset library. Paloma and Aisha finished moving the client folders over Tuesday, and everything from 2021 onward is in Wren now. The older stuff stays archived where it is for now.
2. The new naming convention. Darius put together a one-pager and it's pinned in the channel. Short version: client code, then campaign, then date. I'll show you a couple of examples so it sticks.
3. Your access. Ada set you up with editor rights on Monday. If you can't open the Brightline folder, holler and she'll sort it out.
4. Timeline. Will's hoping to switch off the old drive by the end of the month. So if you've got anything squirreled away on your desktop that should live in Wren, now's the time to move it.

That's about the size of it. You don't need to prep a thing. Just come with your coffee and any "wait, where'd that go?" questions.

If Thursday doesn't suit, just slide it wherever works. My calendar's pretty wide open this week.

Thanks, friend,
Yara

Falconbridge Unified School District · Business Services"},{"spec_id":"spec_0620","text":"Fall Fun Run - Daily Sync (Lefebvre sponsorship blockers)
Monday – Friday · 7:45 – 8:00am
Google Meet: [link]
Guests: Mei (organizer), Xavier Lindqvist, Farid Zapata, Maeve Nwachukwu, Kemi Castellano, Chidi Carvalho

Hi all,

We're 9 days out, and the Lefebvre account has a lot of moving pieces still in flight. So I'm standing up a quick daily sync through race day.

Format (timeboxed, cameras optional):
- Round-robin. Each workstream owner flags anything blocking their lane: route/permits (Xavier), volunteer roster (Farid), sponsor deliverables (Maeve), registration/payments (Kemi), day-of logistics (Chidi).
- Dependency check. Most of our stuff is cross-functional. Lefebvre's banner placement depends on the route map, the route map depends on the city permit, and volunteer shift counts depend on registration numbers. When something slips, the downstream owners need to hear it right then and agree on a workaround on the spot.
- Decisions parking lot. Anything that needs more than 2 minutes gets taken offline with just the people involved.

Please update your row in the tracker before the call: [link]. That way we skip the status readouts and spend the 15 min on the cross-team stuff.

Zainab from the front office may drop in once or twice re: the school facilities sign-off.

I know 7:45 is early, but it's the only slot that works before drop-off for everyone. I'll cancel any day we truly have nothing to unblock.

Thanks for hustling on this!
Mei
Willowpoint Elementary PTA"}]}
